changes.title: Fleuria
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
Exact Color: Champagne Ivory with Lavender, Blush Pink & Soft Lilac Floral Prints, finished with Dusty Mauve Banarsi Frills.

Description

Step into a world of romantic elegance with Fleuria, a captivating floral lehenga choli ensemble that beautifully blends delicate craftsmanship with contemporary femininity.

Crafted from luxurious printed satin tissue fabric, the beautifully tailored blouse showcases enchanting floral prints in soft shades of lavender, blush pink, and lilac against a delicate champagne ivory base. Intricately embellished with shimmering sequins, lustrous pearls, and sparkling cut-glass beads, the blouse features a delicately scalloped neckline and beautifully embroidered scalloped borders along the sleeves and hemline, finished with dainty pearl drops for an exquisite touch. The elegantly designed open back adds a refined and graceful appeal.

Paired with a voluminous printed satin tissue lehenga, the ensemble showcases a mesmerizing arrangement of oversized floral motifs in romantic pastel hues. Delicate gotta lace embellishments gracefully accentuate the skirt panels, adding definition and a subtle shimmer to its flowing silhouette.

The true highlight is the beautifully layered Banarsi fabric frills along the lehenga's hemline, featuring soft dusty mauve tones that create a luxurious, romantic finish while enhancing the skirt's dramatic flare and graceful movement.

A beautiful harmony of floral artistry, delicate embellishments, and luxurious textures, Fleuria is an effortlessly enchanting statement ensemble, perfect for wedding festivities, daytime celebrations, and elegant festive occasions.


Details:
Model size Small
Blouse length 13.5 inches
Skirt length 46 inches with frills

changes.before:
Exact Color: Pastel Multicolor – Blush Pink, Powder Blue, Soft Lilac & Butter Yellow

Description

Nazneen is a captivating celebration of soft pastel hues, delicate floral prints, and exquisite craftsmanship. Designed in a harmonious blend of blush pink, powder blue, soft lilac, and butter yellow, this enchanting ensemble radiates effortless elegance and feminine charm.

The printed Shisha Silk jacket features intricate floral and bird-inspired motifs, beautifully enhanced with delicate hand embellishments of pearls, shimmering sequins, and cut-glass beads. Its structured silhouette, full-length sleeves, and sparkling embellished borders add a refined touch of sophistication.

Paired with a beautifully hand-embellished blouse, the ensemble combines timeless craftsmanship with contemporary elegance. The blouse features delicate sparkling embellishments that complement the intricate detailing of the jacket.

The flowing printed Shisha Silk skirt showcases a graceful arrangement of multicolored floral patterns across beautifully crafted panels. Delicate gotta laces accentuate each panel, while the intricately finished hemline adds a luxurious touch. The skirt's voluminous silhouette creates an elegant, flowing movement with every step.

A perfect blend of romantic pastels and traditional artistry, Nazneen is an enchanting choice for festive celebrations, wedding festivities, and elegant daytime occasions.
